pages_checked.file_inventory: Each pull's complete files endpoint fit on one 100-file page and matched its reported changed_files count.

matching_prs.title: Upgrade Ruff to 0.16.0 and make Workers CI reliable
matching_prs.classification: Existing integration suite repaired within a Ruff upgrade
matching_prs.weakness: The header tests depended on public httpbin availability and trusted the Worker's response about which requests arrived. Echo-service errors could obscure a known httpx header defect. The dev-server fixture terminated its parent process alone.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Run the existing Worker clients against a real loopback HTTP server during tests. Check received requests before classifying an expected failure, surface upstream HTTP errors, and terminate the dev server's process group.
diff_evidence: header_echo_server starts ThreadingHTTPServer on an ephemeral loopback port, records received headers and supplies the URL to the Worker with ECHO_URL. The process fixture starts a new session and signals its process group.

test_3_httpx_headers checks for two requests carrying the literal X-Custom value before its existing expected failure. test_5_sync_http_libraries checks two recorded requests and their User-Agent and X-Custom values. The latter still reads its expected values from result['headers_sent'].
3-httpx-headers/src/entry.py adds HTTP status checks for both httpx and js.fetch. 5-sync-http-libraries/src/entry.py accepts the same echo destination override.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Exercise a real protocol against a controlled peer. Observe receipt at that peer and verify setup before treating a failure as the known defect.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged on 2026-10-09. The PR job log records 2 passed, 3 skipped and 1 xfailed. The post-merge test step succeeded. The deployed R2 cases were skipped. Request count and matching headers alone cannot identify the library that emitted each request.

matching_prs.title: Strict known-bug tests, issue 2 byte oracle, issue 4 fastapi<0.142 pin, pre-commit hooks in CI
matching_prs.classification: Explicit audit and strengthening of existing regression and known-bug tests
matching_prs.weakness: Imperative xfails allowed an upstream fix to go unnoticed and could excuse recurrence of a resolved truncation bug. Size checks and a repeating seed missed equal-length corruption. Blocking startup reads could defeat a timeout on a silent subprocess.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Make recurrence of resolved issue 2 fail normally and unexpected passes of active issues fail the suite. Verify the contents of both ordinary and streaming reads, and enforce the fixture's startup deadline while draining server output.
diff_evidence: active_issue sets xfail(strict=True, raises=PlatformBugReproduced) for issues 3, 4a and 4b. test_2_fastapi_r2_streaming replaces its truncation xfail with a plain assertion. The dev-server fixture now starts for xfail-marked tests.
2-fastapi-r2-streaming/src/app.py seeds 32,768 position-encoded big-endian words. test_2 checks the first misplaced word in both /read and /stream after checking length.
tests/conftest.py drains output on a thread, reads a queue to a monotonic deadline, reports early EOF with the return code, and flags XPASS(strict) in the test summary.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Make a known-bug test distinguish reproduction, an unexpected fix, and unrelated failures. For binary integrity, use a payload whose positions are distinguishable and check content after transport.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged on 2026-10-11. The PR job log records 2 passed, 3 skipped and 1 xfailed. Post-merge CI also passed. Deployment-only tests 4a, 4b and 4c were skipped, leaving the new strict expectations for 4a and 4b unexercised there. PR #4 contributed the /read check. The merged change added /stream coverage and retained PR #2's HTTP fixture.

matching_prs.title: Test audit: unbreak main (pin fastapi below 0.142), byte-level issue 2 oracle, wire-level issue 5 oracle
matching_prs.classification: Explicit test audit, closed with part of the attempt incorporated in PR #3
matching_prs.weakness: The 128 KiB read assertion accepted same-length corruption. The repeated 256-byte seed also made whole reordered chunks indistinguishable. The synchronous HTTP test compared values reported by the Worker with expectations from the same response.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Use position-encoded binary data, compare every word of the read, and verify literal headers and client-tagged request counts at a test-owned echo server.
diff_evidence: 2-fastapi-r2-streaming/src/worker.py replaces bytes(range(256)) * 512 with 32,768 indexed words. test_2_fastapi_r2_streaming checks the first misplaced word after /read. The /stream byte check arrived in #3.

tests/echo_server.py records each incoming request's query and headers. test_5_sync_http_libraries expects exactly the two tags requests and urllib3, compares the received values against literals, and exercises the default live HTTPS path.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: Design payloads that expose plausible corruption and source expected results independently of the implementation. Challenge the old and revised tests with the same deliberately introduced faults.
matching_prs.outcome: GitHub records this PR as closed without merging it directly. Its head CI log records 2 passed, 3 skipped and 1 xfailed. The PR author reports old-vs-new checks against planted faults, including reordered chunks and a missing client request. Those experiments were not rerun. Commit bb85ace9 brought this branch into #3, which retained the byte checks and adopted #2's HTTP approach. The proposed HTTP tags were assigned by the Worker and could not independently establish the library's identity.

matching_prs.title: Capture runtime and HTTP testing lessons from the Ruff rollout
matching_prs.classification: Explicit testing guidance and audit retrospective, documentation only
matching_prs.weakness: The existing write-up did not explain which header behavior CI observed, how a dependency or startup failure could obscure it, or which deployment paths the green suite skipped.
matching_prs.attempted_remedy: Record the HTTP evidence, runtime versions and coverage gaps behind PR #2. Link the dated findings and reusable guidance from the README.
diff_evidence: LESSONS_LEARNED.md adds sections 7 and 8. They specify receipt of real requests at a controlled echo service, checking control paths before a known-bug xfail, comparing base and head, and reporting skipped deployment cases and missing negative controls.
README.md links the testing lessons. The PR changes two documentation files. The executable fixture and assertion changes belong to #2.
matching_prs.transferable_rule: When documenting a green integration run, state the behavior observed, the tested environment, the skipped paths, and any fault-detection checks that were actually performed.
matching_prs.outcome: Merged on 2026-10-09. CI for the unchanged suite records 2 passed, 3 skipped and 1 xfailed. This is a guidance contribution linked to #2, with no second implementation of the fixes.

exclusions.reason: Product dependency fix only. The sole change adds workers-runtime-sdk>=1.1.1 to the streaming example's pyproject.toml. It did not strengthen its existing regression assertion.
Pinned GitHub Actions and added an immutable-reference policy check. The diff changes workflow and dependency-update configuration with no repair to the existing test suite or its approach.
Open Dependabot group bump. Both changed workflow files update action revisions only.

limitations: All seven PR titles, bodies and file inventories were screened across states, authors and dates. The linked job outcomes were inspected without rerunning the Workers or deploying to Cloudflare.
The three implementation PRs overlap. PR #5 documents #2's work. Treat them as separate historical PRs without counting each as an independent shipped repair.
